275:             return Err(ProbeAuthoringError::Busy);
276:         }
277:         if !self.active_branch().world.playback.paused {
278:             return Err(ProbeAuthoringError::NotPaused);
279:         }
280:         Ok(())
281:     }
282: 
283:     fn validate_probe_candidate(&self, candidate: &BodyState) -> Result<(), ProbeAuthoringError> {
284:         use ProbeAuthoringError::InvalidCandidate as invalid;
285:         let id = &candidate.body_id.0;
286:         if id.trim().is_empty() || id.len() > 96 || id.chars().any(char::is_control) {
287:             return Err(invalid("The probe name is invalid"));
288:         }
289:         if self
290:             .active_branch()
291:             .world
292:             .bodies
293:             .iter()
294:             .any(|body| body.body_id.0.eq_ignore_ascii_case(id))
295:         {
296:             return Err(invalid("A body already has this probe name"));
297:         }
298:         if !candidate.mass_kg.is_finite()
299:             || candidate.mass_kg <= 0.0
300:             || !candidate.source_mass_kg.is_finite()
301:             || candidate.source_mass_kg < 0.0
302:             || !candidate.radius_m.is_finite()
303:             || candidate.radius_m <= 0.0
304:             || !finite_vector(candidate.position_m)
305:             || !finite_vector(candidate.velocity_mps)
306:         {
307:             return Err(invalid(
308:                 "Probe position, velocity, mass and radius must be finite and physically valid",
309:             ));
310:         }
311:         let mut bodies = self.active_branch().world.bodies.clone();
312:         bodies.push(candidate.clone());
313:         if !finite_invariants(compute_world_invariants(&bodies)) {
314:             return Err(ProbeAuthoringError::NumericalRange);
315:         }
316:         Ok(())
317:     }
318: }
319: 
320: impl ProbePreviewPlan {
321:     pub fn run(mut self) -> Result<ProbePreview, ProbeAuthoringError> {
322:         let mut solver_bodies = world_bodies_to_solver_state(&self.bodies);
323:         let candidate_index = self.bodies.len() - 1;
324:         let mut previous = relative_position(&self.bodies, candidate_index, self.reference_index);
325:         let mut samples = vec![ProbePreviewSample {
326:             elapsed_seconds: 0.0,
327:             position_m: previous,
328:         }];
329:         let radius = self.reference_body.radius_m + self.candidate_radius_m;
330:         let mut intersects = false;
331:         let mut steps = 0;
332:         let mut epoch = self.epoch_seconds;
333:         for _ in 0..PREVIEW_INTERVALS {
334:             let policy = preview_policy(&self.configured_policy, self.lab_policy, &self.bodies);
335:             let count = checked_substep_count(&policy, self.interval_seconds)
336:                 .ok_or(ProbeAuthoringError::NumericalRange)?;
455:             .iter()
456:             .find(|body| body.body_id.0 == "earth")
457:             .unwrap();
458:         let distance = earth.radius_m + 800_000.0;
459:         BodyState {
460:             body_id: BodyId("probe-1".into()),
461:             body_class: BodyClass::Spacecraft,
462:             mass_kg: 1_000.0,
463:             source_mass_kg: 0.0,
464:             radius_m: 2.0,
465:             position_m: Vector3d {
466:                 x: earth.position_m.x + distance,
467:                 ..earth.position_m
468:             },
469:             velocity_mps: Vector3d {
470:                 y: earth.velocity_mps.y + (6.67430e-11 * earth.source_mass_kg / distance).sqrt(),
471:                 ..earth.velocity_mps
472:             },
473:         }
474:     }
475: 
476:     fn preview(runtime: &WorldRuntime, body: BodyState) -> ProbePreview {
477:         runtime
478:             .prepare_probe_preview(body, &BodyId("earth".into()), 43_200.0)
479:             .unwrap()
480:             .run()
481:             .unwrap()
482:     }

484:     #[test]
485:     fn preview_retains_the_saved_world_step_model() {
486:         for policy in [lab_step::LabStepPolicy::LegacyDistanceV1, lab_step::LabStepPolicy::PeriapsisV2] {
487:             let mut world = lab();
488:             world.lab_step_policy = policy;
489:             let restored = WorldRuntime::import_saved_session(&world.export_saved_session().unwrap(), world.hardware_profile.clone()).unwrap();
490:             let draft = candidate(&restored);
491:             let plan = restored.prepare_probe_preview(draft, &BodyId("earth".into()), 3_600.0).unwrap();
492:             assert_eq!(plan.lab_policy, Some(policy));
493:             assert_eq!(preview_policy(&plan.configured_policy, plan.lab_policy, &plan.bodies),
494:                 policy.for_world(&restored.config.physics, &plan.bodies));
495:         }
496:     }

527:     #[test]
528:     fn preview_samples_match_committed_propagation_including_explicit_source_mass() {
529:         for source_mass in [0.0, 1.0e20] {
530:             let mut runtime = lab();
531:             let mut body = candidate(&runtime);
532:             body.source_mass_kg = source_mass;
533:             let result = preview(&runtime, body.clone());
534:             runtime
535:                 .commit_probe(body, result.baseline_revision, result.epoch_seconds, 2)
536:                 .unwrap();
537:             let dt = result.samples[1].elapsed_seconds;
538:             for sample in result.samples.iter().skip(1) {
539:                 runtime
540:                     .apply_command(WorldCommand::AdvanceEpoch { delta_seconds: dt }, 3)
541:                     .unwrap();
542:                 let bodies = &runtime.active_branch().world.bodies;
543:                 assert_eq!(
544:                     relative_position(bodies, bodies.len() - 1, 1),
545:                     sample.position_m
546:                 );
547:                 assert_eq!(
548:                     runtime.active_branch().world.epoch_seconds,
549:                     result.epoch_seconds + sample.elapsed_seconds
550:                 );
551:             }
552:         }
553:     }

581:     fn malformed_and_overflowing_candidates_cannot_preview_or_commit() {
582:         let mut runtime = lab();
583:         let before = runtime.export_saved_session().unwrap();
584:         let original = candidate(&runtime);
585:         for mode in 0..8 {
586:             let mut body = original.clone();
587:             match mode {
588:                 0 => body.mass_kg = f64::INFINITY,
589:                 1 => body.source_mass_kg = -1.0,
590:                 2 => body.position_m.x = f64::NAN,
591:                 3 => body.velocity_mps.z = f64::INFINITY,
592:                 4 => body.radius_m = 0.0,
593:                 5 => body.body_id = BodyId("EARTH".into()),
594:                 6 => body.body_id = BodyId("bad\nname".into()),
595:                 _ => body.source_mass_kg = 1e300,
596:             }
597:             assert!(runtime
598:                 .prepare_probe_preview(body.clone(), &BodyId("earth".into()), 3600.0)
599:                 .is_err());
600:             assert!(runtime
601:                 .commit_probe(body, runtime.snapshot_revision(), 0.0, 2)
602:                 .is_err());
603:             assert_eq!(before, runtime.export_saved_session().unwrap());
604:         }
605:     }
